A.description: Closed lips: M, B, P. Speech holds every speech morph at zero, overriding mood mouth shapes.

B.description: Slightly open, teeth near closed: most consonants (K, S, T) and EE.

C.description: Open: EH and AE, as in men and bat.

D.description: Wide open: AA, as in father.

E.description: Slightly rounded: AO and ER, as in off and bird.

F.description: Puckered: UW, OW and W, as in you, show and way.

G.description: Upper teeth on lower lip: F and V. Candidate only; the PMX may lack this geometry.

X.description: Rest during pauses. Speech releases the mouth back to the active mood.
